mapper.select: SELECT symbol_id AS "symbolId" , kind AS "kind" , fqn AS "fqn" , simple_name AS "simpleName" , visibility AS "visibility" , is_abstract AS "isAbstract" , layer AS "layer" , layer_confidence AS "layerConfidence" , properties_json->>'synthetic' AS "synthetic" , line_start AS "lineStart" , line_end AS "lineEnd" FROM analysis_symbol WHERE file_id = #{fileId} ORDER BY line_start, fqn

SELECT owner_symbol_id AS "ownerSymbolId" , name AS "name" , type AS "type" , is_static AS "isStatic" , is_synthetic AS "isSynthetic" FROM analysis_field WHERE file_id = #{fileId} ORDER BY line_start, name

SELECT method_id AS "methodId" , owner_symbol_id AS "ownerSymbolId" , name AS "name" , signature AS "signature" , return_type AS "returnType" , param_count AS "paramCount" , visibility AS "visibility" , is_static AS "isStatic" , is_abstract AS "isAbstract" , is_constructor AS "isConstructor" , is_synthetic AS "isSynthetic" , synthetic_origin AS "syntheticOrigin" , proxy_related AS "proxyRelated" , line_start AS "lineStart" , line_end AS "lineEnd" FROM analysis_method WHERE file_id = #{fileId} ORDER BY line_start, signature

SELECT target_kind AS "targetKind" , target_id AS "targetId" , annotation_name AS "name" , attributes_json::text AS "attributes" FROM analysis_annotation WHERE file_id = #{fileId} AND target_kind IN ('TYPE', 'METHOD') ORDER BY annotation_id

SELECT r.from_id AS "fromId" , r.relation_type AS "relationType" , COALESCE(s.fqn, r.to_external) AS "target" FROM analysis_relation r LEFT JOIN analysis_symbol s ON s.revision_id = r.revision_id AND s.symbol_id = r.to_id WHERE r.file_id = #{fileId} AND r.relation_type IN ('EXTENDS', 'IMPLEMENTS', 'INJECTS') ORDER BY r.relation_id

SELECT DISTINCT r.from_id AS "fromId" , r.relation_type AS "relationType" , r.confidence AS "confidence" , (r.to_id IS NOT NULL) AS "inProject" , COALESCE(ts.fqn || '#' || tm.signature, r.to_external) AS "target" FROM analysis_relation r LEFT JOIN analysis_method tm ON tm.revision_id = r.revision_id AND tm.method_id = r.to_id LEFT JOIN analysis_symbol ts ON ts.revision_id = tm.revision_id AND ts.symbol_id = tm.owner_symbol_id WHERE r.file_id = #{fileId} AND r.relation_type IN ('CALLS', 'CALLS_POSSIBLE_IMPLEMENTATION')

SELECT t.to_id AS "toId", t.caller AS "caller", t.total AS "total" FROM ( SELECT x.to_id, x.caller , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY x.to_id ORDER BY x.caller) AS rn , COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY x.to_id) AS total FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT r.to_id , COALESCE(cs.fqn || '#' || cm.signature, fs.fqn || '#' || cf.name, ts.fqn, '화면 ' || ff.path) AS caller FROM analysis_method m JOIN analysis_relation r ON r.revision_id = m.revision_id AND r.to_id = m.method_id AND r.relation_type IN ('CALLS', 'CALLS_POSSIBLE_IMPLEMENTATION', 'REQUESTS') LEFT JOIN analysis_method cm ON r.from_kind = 'METHOD' AND cm.revision_id = r.revision_id AND cm.method_id = r.from_id LEFT JOIN analysis_symbol cs ON cs.revision_id = cm.revision_id AND cs.symbol_id = cm.owner_symbol_id LEFT JOIN analysis_field cf ON r.from_kind = 'FIELD' AND cf.revision_id = r.revision_id AND cf.field_id = r.from_id LEFT JOIN analysis_symbol fs ON fs.revision_id = cf.revision_id AND fs.symbol_id = cf.owner_symbol_id LEFT JOIN analysis_symbol ts ON r.from_kind = 'TYPE' AND ts.revision_id = r.revision_id AND ts.symbol_id = r.from_id -- 이 메소드의 주소를 요청하는 화면(JSP). 파일을 가리키는 ID 는 'F' + file_id 다 LEFT JOIN analysis_file ff ON ff.file_id = CASE WHEN r.from_kind = 'FILE' THEN CAST(substr(r.from_id, 2) AS bigint) END WHERE m.file_id = #{fileId} AND r.from_id <> r.to_id ) x WHERE x.caller IS NOT NULL ) t WHERE t.rn <= #{limit} ORDER BY t.to_id, t.rn

SELECT DISTINCT r.from_id AS "fromId" , 'SQL' AS "kind" , (COALESCE(mp.namespace || '.', '') || mp.statement_id) AS "name" , mp.statement_type AS "statementType" , (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT t.to_external || '(' || COALESCE(t.properties_json->>'crud', '?') || ')', ', ') FROM analysis_relation t WHERE t.revision_id = r.revision_id AND t.from_id = r.to_id AND t.relation_type IN ('READS_TABLE', 'WRITES_TABLE')) AS "tables" FROM analysis_method me JOIN analysis_relation r ON r.revision_id = me.revision_id AND r.from_id = me.method_id AND r.relation_type = 'EXECUTES_SQL' AND r.to_id IS NOT NULL JOIN analysis_mapper mp ON mp.mapper_id = CASE WHEN r.to_kind = 'SQL' THEN CAST(substr(r.to_id, 2) AS bigint) END WHERE me.file_id = #{fileId} UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT r.from_id, 'VIEW', f.path, NULL, NULL FROM analysis_method me JOIN analysis_relation r ON r.revision_id = me.revision_id AND r.from_id = me.method_id AND r.relation_type = 'RENDERS' JOIN analysis_file f ON f.file_id = CASE WHEN r.to_kind = 'FILE' THEN CAST(substr(r.to_id, 2) AS bigint) END WHERE me.file_id = #{fileId} ORDER BY 1, 2, 3

SELECT mapper_id AS "mapperId" , mapper_type AS "mapperType" , namespace AS "namespace" , statement_id AS "statementId" , statement_type AS "statementType" , parameter_type AS "parameterType" , result_type AS "resultType" , sql_body AS "sqlBody" , line_start AS "lineStart" , line_end AS "lineEnd" FROM analysis_mapper WHERE file_id = #{fileId} AND statement_type <> 'SQL_FRAGMENT' ORDER BY mapper_id

SELECT DISTINCT r.from_id AS "fromId" , r.to_external AS "table" , COALESCE(r.properties_json->>'crud', 'R') AS "crud" FROM analysis_relation r WHERE r.file_id = #{fileId} AND r.from_kind = 'SQL' AND r.relation_type IN ('READS_TABLE', 'WRITES_TABLE') ORDER BY 1, 2, 3

SELECT DISTINCT r.to_id AS "toId" , (s.fqn || '#' || me.signature) AS "caller" FROM analysis_mapper mp JOIN analysis_relation r ON r.revision_id = mp.revision_id AND r.to_id = 'S' || mp.mapper_id AND r.relation_type = 'EXECUTES_SQL' JOIN analysis_method me ON me.revision_id = r.revision_id AND me.method_id = r.from_id JOIN analysis_symbol s ON s.revision_id = me.revision_id AND s.symbol_id = me.owner_symbol_id WHERE mp.file_id = #{fileId} ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT DISTINCT 'OPENED_BY' AS "kind", NULL::varchar AS "text", (s.fqn || '#' || me.signature)::varchar AS "target" FROM analysis_relation r JOIN analysis_method me ON me.revision_id = r.revision_id AND me.method_id = r.from_id JOIN analysis_symbol s ON s.revision_id = me.revision_id AND s.symbol_id = me.owner_symbol_id WHERE r.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND r.to_id = #{fileNodeId} AND r.relation_type = 'RENDERS' UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT 'REQUESTS', (r.properties_json->>'path')::varchar, (s.fqn || '#' || me.signature)::varchar FROM analysis_relation r JOIN analysis_method me ON me.revision_id = r.revision_id AND me.method_id = r.to_id JOIN analysis_symbol s ON s.revision_id = me.revision_id AND s.symbol_id = me.owner_symbol_id WHERE r.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND r.from_id = #{fileNodeId} AND r.relation_type = 'REQUESTS' UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT 'INCLUDES', NULL::varchar, f.path::varchar FROM analysis_relation r JOIN analysis_file f ON f.file_id = CASE WHEN r.to_kind = 'FILE' THEN CAST(substr(r.to_id, 2) AS bigint) END WHERE r.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND r.from_id = #{fileNodeId} AND r.relation_type = 'INCLUDES' UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT 'INCLUDED_BY', NULL::varchar, f.path::varchar FROM analysis_relation r JOIN analysis_file f ON f.file_id = CASE WHEN r.from_kind = 'FILE' THEN CAST(substr(r.from_id, 2) AS bigint) END WHERE r.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND r.to_id = #{fileNodeId} AND r.relation_type = 'INCLUDES' UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT 'CALLS', NULL::varchar, (s.fqn || '#' || me.signature)::varchar FROM analysis_relation r JOIN analysis_method me ON me.revision_id = r.revision_id AND me.method_id = r.to_id JOIN analysis_symbol s ON s.revision_id = me.revision_id AND s.symbol_id = me.owner_symbol_id WHERE r.file_id = #{fileId} AND r.relation_type = 'CALLS' AND r.from_id <> r.to_id ORDER BY 1, 2, 3

SELECT e.method_id AS "methodId" , e.endpoint_type AS "endpointType" , e.http_method AS "httpMethod" , e.path AS "path" FROM analysis_endpoint e JOIN analysis_method m ON m.revision_id = e.revision_id AND m.method_id = e.method_id WHERE e.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND m.file_id = #{fileId} ORDER BY e.endpoint_type, e.path
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rag_document (document_id, source_type, project_id, revision_id, doc_type, ref_kind, ref_id, title, source_path, metadata_json, content_hash) VALUES (#{documentId}, 'CODE', #{projectId}, #{revisionId}, #{docType}, #{refKind}, #{refId}, #{title}, #{sourcePath} , CAST(#{metadataJson} AS jsonb), #{contentHash})

INSERT INTO rag_embedding (content_hash, model, dimensions, status) SELECT DISTINCT c.content_hash, #{model}, #{dimensions}, 'PENDING' FROM rag_chunk c WHERE c.file_id = #{fileId} ON CONFLICT (content_hash, model) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT e.content_hash AS "contentHash" , (SELECT c.content FROM rag_chunk c WHERE c.content_hash = e.content_hash LIMIT 1) AS "content" FROM rag_embedding e WHERE e.status = 'PENDING' AND e.model = #{model} ORDER BY e.priority DESC, e.created_at, e.content_hash LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE rag_embedding SET embedding = CAST(#{vector} AS vector) , status = 'DONE' , last_error = NULL , embedded_at = now() WHERE content_hash = #{contentHash} AND model = #{model}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM rag_embedding e WHERE e.created_at < now() - make_interval(days => #{days}) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rag_chunk c WHERE c.content_hash = e.content_hash)
mapper.select: SELECT d.doc_type AS "docType" , COUNT(DISTINCT d.doc_seq) AS "documents" , COUNT(c.chunk_id) AS "chunks" , COALESCE(SUM(c.char_count), 0) AS "chars" FROM rag_document d LEFT JOIN rag_chunk c ON c.doc_seq = d.doc_seq WHERE d.revision_id = #{revisionId} GROUP BY d.doc_type ORDER BY d.doc_type
SELECT revision_id FROM analysis_revision WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND status = 'READY' ORDER BY revision_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT d.doc_seq FROM rag_document d WHERE AND d.document_id = #{sourceId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rag_document (document_id, source_type, tenant, project_id, doc_type, ref_kind, title, source_path, metadata_json, content_hash) VALUES (#{sourceId}, 'DOCUMENT', #{tenant}, #{projectId}, 'UPLOAD', 'DOCUMENT', #{title}, #{fileName} , CAST(#{metadataJson} AS jsonb), #{contentHash})

INSERT INTO rag_chunk (doc_seq, tenant, chunk_no, chunk_type, content, content_hash, char_count, metadata_json) VALUES
(#{docSeq}, #{tenant}, #{c.chunkNo}, 'UPLOAD', #{c.content}, #{c.contentHash}, #{c.charCount}, CAST(#{metadataJson} AS jsonb))

INSERT INTO rag_embedding (content_hash, model, dimensions, status, priority) SELECT DISTINCT c.content_hash, #{model}, #{dimensions}, 'PENDING', #{priority} FROM rag_chunk c WHERE c.doc_seq = #{docSeq} ON CONFLICT (content_hash, model) DO UPDATE SET priority = GREATEST(rag_embedding.priority, EXCLUDED.priority) WHERE rag_embedding.status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rag_document d

SELECT d.document_id AS "sourceId" , d.title AS "title" , d.source_path AS "fileName" , d.project_id AS "projectId" , d.tenant AS "tenant" , d.metadata_json::text AS "metadata" , to_char(d.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "createdAt" , COUNT(c.chunk_id) AS "chunks" , COUNT(e.content_hash) FILTER (WHERE e.status = 'DONE') AS "embedded" FROM rag_document d LEFT JOIN rag_chunk c ON c.doc_seq = d.doc_seq LEFT JOIN rag_embedding e ON e.content_hash = c.content_hash AND e.model = #{model}
GROUP BY d.doc_seq ORDER BY d.created_at DESC, d.doc_seq DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.sql: c.chunk_id AS "chunkId" , d.source_type AS "sourceType" , d.doc_type AS "docType" , d.title AS "title" , d.ref_kind AS "refKind" , d.ref_id AS "refId" , d.source_path AS "path" , c.line_start AS "lineStart" , c.line_end AS "lineEnd" , c.chunk_no AS "chunkNo" , c.metadata_json::text AS "metadata" , c.content AS "content"
mapper.select:
SELECT ROUND((1 - (e.embedding <=> CAST(#{vector} AS vector)))::numeric, 4) AS "score" , FROM rag_embedding e JOIN rag_chunk c ON c.content_hash = e.content_hash JOIN rag_document d ON d.doc_seq = c.doc_seq WHERE e.model = #{model} AND e.status = 'DONE'
ORDER BY e.embedding <=> CAST(#{vector} AS vector) LIMIT #{topK}

SELECT k.* FROM ( SELECT ROUND((1 - (e.embedding <=> CAST(#{vector} AS vector)))::numeric, 4) CAST(NULL AS numeric) AS "score" , ( CASE WHEN lower(d.title) ~ #{k.pattern} THEN 3 WHEN strpos(lower(d.title), #{k.text}) > 0 THEN 2 WHEN strpos(lower(c.content), #{k.text}) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS "keywordScore" , FROM rag_chunk c JOIN rag_document d ON d.doc_seq = c.doc_seq LEFT JOIN rag_embedding e ON e.content_hash = c.content_hash AND e.model = #{model} AND e.status = 'DONE' WHERE 1 = 1
AND ( strpos(lower(d.title), #{k.text}) > 0 OR strpos(lower(c.content), #{k.text}) > 0 ) ) k ORDER BY k."keywordScore" DESC, k."score" DESC NULLS LAST, k."chunkId" LIMIT #{topK}
